rules: One step per branch. The branch name is the claim: step/<id>-<slug>.
A step can start only when every dependsOn step is complete on main.
plan/<slug> branches may change only pmo/data/** and docs/**. Nothing else.
release/<slug> branches may change only package.json and package-lock.json.
Never commit to main directly; every change arrives by pull request.

commit.example: [1.1.1] Extract PMO into a standalone package

frozenPaths.reason: Legacy monolith (3k+ lines). It only shrinks: change it in a step that lists legacy-store.
Legacy UI monolith (7k+ lines). It only shrinks: change it in a step that lists legacy-ui.
Legacy API surface. New endpoints belong to a module's own router.
The PMO Agent charter. Change it only through a reviewed step or plan branch that lists pmo.
Local environment. Never committed; put new settings in .env.example and secrets in .env.local.

prChecklist: Step status, evidence and completedAt are set in pmo/data/plan.json, with evidence paths that exist.
npm test passes; new behaviour has tests.
Every guardrail that applies is named in the description with how it is met.
New settings are in .env.example; no secret is committed or sent to the browser.
UI changes were exercised, or the description says they were not.
